brief:
Israeli occupation forces and settlers intensified military operations across the West Bank and occupied Jerusalem on Thursday, conducting widespread incursions into towns and villages throughout the territories, Shehab Wire reported. The operations included raids on residential homes and commercial establishments, along with assaults on Palestinian civilians in the affected areas.

The escalation encompassed coordinated sweeps across multiple locations, combining large-scale incursions with targeted house-to-house searches. Forces and settlers engaged in what Palestinian officials characterized as provocative actions against residents during the operations, which affected scattered areas across both the occupied Palestinian territories and East Jerusalem.
